id: 04_VTU Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory Familiarization of Switches and Rheostats G
title: 变阻器与开关
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/04_VTU Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory Familiarization of Switches and Rheostats G.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/04_VTU Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory Familiarization of Switches and Rheostats G/src.py

points.K4: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流
points.K9: 任取两端：一固定一滑动

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有一根长长的滑线变阻器和几个开关，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a long tubular sliding rheostat and several switches, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识变阻器和各种开关。

shots.scene: 变阻器、船形开关、闸刀开关三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a tubular sliding rheostat, a rocker switch and a knife-blade changeover switch. No people.
shots.narration: 一个调电阻，一个管通断。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一根长长的滑线变阻器，左看右看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a long slide-wire rheostat and turns it around, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿着变阻器，不知道怎么接。

shots.scene: 台上摆着几种外形不同的开关，阿杰挠头
shots.prompt_en: Several switches of different shapes lie on the bench; the young male student scratches his head.
shots.narration: 开关也有好几种，长得都不一样。

shots.scene: 小研拿起一个开关，指着上面的触点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a switch and points to its contacts.
shots.narration: 小研说：做实验前，这些都得认清。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 一个调电阻，一个管通断，一起来看。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着变阻器和一排开关
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a rheostat and a row of different switches.
shots.narration: 做实验前，先把它们认清楚。

shots.scene: 电阻符号上加一个斜箭头
shots.prompt_en: A resistor symbol with a diagonal arrow across it. No people.
shots.narration: 变阻器，就是阻值可以调的电阻。

shots.scene: 变阻器特写：瓷管上密绕电阻丝，上方有滑块
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a tubular rheostat: resistance wire tightly wound on a ceramic tube, with a slider on a bar above it. No people.
shots.narration: 瓷管上绕着电阻丝，上面有个滑块。

shots.scene: 两端和滑块处三个接线柱被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The two end terminals and the slider terminal of the rheostat highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 两头是固定端，滑块是滑动端。

shots.section_title: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流
shots.scene: 变阻器侧面的空白铭牌，旁边是电阻和电流图标
shots.prompt_en: The side of a rheostat with a blank nameplate, a resistor icon and a current icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 铭牌上标着阻值和额定电流。
overlay: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流

shots.section_title: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流
shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着电流图标的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a current arrow icon.
shots.narration: 比如这台二百欧、一点五安，两个数一样重要。

shots.scene: 长段电阻丝和短段电阻丝对比
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a long section of resistance wire with a big resistance bar, a short section with a small bar. No people.
shots.narration: 接入的电阻丝越长，电阻越大。

shots.scene: 滑块位置使整根电阻丝都接入，电流箭头走完全程
shots.prompt_en: A rheostat icon with the slider positioned so that current arrows travel the entire length of the wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻丝全长接入，电阻最大。

shots.scene: 滑块位置使电流只走一小段
shots.prompt_en: A rheostat icon with the slider positioned so that current arrows travel only a short section of wire. No people.
shots.narration: 只接入一小段，电阻最小。

shots.scene: 老周指着三电压表电路图里的变阻器
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the rheostat in a three-voltmeter circuit diagram on a board.
shots.narration: 后面三电压表法实验，要用到它。

shots.scene: 两种变阻器符号并排
shots.prompt_en: Two rheostat circuit symbols side by side: a zigzag resistor with a diagonal arrow, and a box resistor with a sliding arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 画电路图时，用这两种符号。

shots.scene: 符号一端标固定，箭头端标可变
shots.prompt_en: One rheostat symbol with one end marked by a fixed pin icon and the arrow marked by a slider icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一端固定，箭头那端可变。

shots.section_title: 任取两端：一固定一滑动
shots.scene: 小研把导线接到一个固定端和滑动端
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student connects leads to one fixed terminal and the sliding terminal of a rheostat.
shots.narration: 任取两个端子：一个固定端，一个滑动端。
overlay: 任取两端：一固定一滑动

shots.section_title: 任取两端：一固定一滑动
shots.scene: 滑块左右移动，电阻条变长变短
shots.prompt_en: The slider moves left and right while a resistance bar grows and shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 滑块位置，决定是切入还是切出。

shots.scene: 楼梯两头的开关控制同一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a switch at the bottom and top controlling one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 双控、多地控制照明，都要用到开关。

shots.scene: 一个开关图标，标出“极”和“掷”
shots.prompt_en: A switch symbol with its moving blade and its contact points highlighted in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 开关看两样：几个极，几个掷。

shots.scene: 单极单掷开关符号和一个船形开关
shots.prompt_en: A single pole single throw switch symbol next to a black rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 单极单掷：一个极，一个位置。

shots.scene: 电池、开关、灯泡电路：开关断开灯灭，闭合灯亮
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit icons: battery, open switch and dark bulb; battery, closed switch and lit bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 断开就断电，闭合就接通。

shots.scene: 单极双掷开关符号：一个刀片可拨到两个位置
shots.prompt_en: A single pole double throw switch symbol: one blade that can swing to position one or position two. No people.
shots.narration: 单极双掷：一个极，两个位置。

shots.scene: 刀片先接位置一，再接位置二
shots.prompt_en: The blade connected to position one, then switching over to position two. No people.
shots.narration: 同一时刻只接一个位置。

shots.scene: 两只单极双掷开关控制楼梯灯
shots.prompt_en: Two single pole double throw switches at both ends of a staircase controlling one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 双控照明，就靠它。

shots.scene: 双极单掷开关符号：两个刀片用虚线连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A double pole single throw switch symbol: two blades linked by a dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 双极单掷：两个极一起动作。

shots.scene: 一只开关同时接通两路电路
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one double pole switch connecting two separate circuits to their loads at the same time. No people.
shots.narration: 一扳，两路电路同时接通。

shots.scene: 双极双掷开关符号和一个方形开关
shots.prompt_en: A double pole double throw switch symbol next to a square rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 双极双掷：两个极，两个位置。

shots.scene: 触点示意：常开和常闭
shots.prompt_en: A contact diagram icon showing a normally open pair and a normally closed pair. No people.
shots.narration: 触点分常开和常闭，用在复杂电路。

shots.scene: 四种开关符号排成两行两列
shots.prompt_en: Four switch symbols arranged in a two by two grid: single pole single throw, single pole double throw, double pole single throw, double pole double throw. No people.
shots.narration: 单极还是双极，单掷还是双掷？

shots.scene: 阿杰对着图数手指，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student counts on his fingers in front of the grid; the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 数一数极和掷，就分清了。

shots.scene: 三极单掷开关符号：三个刀片连动
shots.prompt_en: A switch symbol with three blades linked by a dashed line, one throw position. No people.
shots.narration: 三极单掷：三个极，一个掷。

shots.scene: 三相电源三根线经开关接到负载
shots.prompt_en: Three supply lines passing through the three-pole switch to a load. No people.
shots.narration: 三个极分别接三相 R、Y、B。

shots.scene: 开关一扳，电源侧和负载侧三相同时亮起
shots.prompt_en: The switch is thrown and all three lines on the supply side and load side light up together. No people.
shots.narration: 电源和负载三相，同时通、同时断。

shots.scene: 实验室的三相转换开关板：三个刀闸、两排接线柱
shots.prompt_en: A three-phase changeover switch board in a lab: three linked blades and two rows of terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 三极双掷：三个极，可拨到位置一或位置二。

shots.scene: 电机图标和电网图标之间一个转换开关
shots.prompt_en: A changeover switch icon between an induction machine icon and a power grid icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它常用作三相转换开关。

shots.scene: 发电机和电网的两条波形逐渐对齐
shots.prompt_en: Two sine waves, one from a generator icon and one from a grid icon, gradually lining up. No people.
shots.narration: 比如感应发电机与电网同步并网的实验。

shots.scene: 变阻器和六种开关图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A rheostat icon and six switch symbols light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 变阻器和开关，是电工实验的基础。

shots.scene: 变阻器滑块在两端的两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two rheostat icons with the slider at opposite ends. No people.
shots.narration: 切入最大，切出最小，看铭牌额定值。

shots.scene: 六种开关符号排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Six switch symbols in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 数极数掷，认清六种开关。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy lab bench with a rheostat and switches.
shots.narration: 认识了变阻器和开关，下次见！
